mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% over the prior 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which increases consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.5% over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in industrial production and housing starts over the prior 3 months signals robust economic activity, which increases corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both INDPRO and HOUST increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), the increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising periods, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 110 over the prior 3 months signals robust manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate output and profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 110 over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the year-over-year CPIAUCSL below 2.0% over the prior 3 months signals easing inflation, reducing the risk of central bank tightening and leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL (y/y) < 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) over the prior 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS increased and UNRATE decreased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 11300 billion dollars over the prior 3 months signals strong economic growth, which increases corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 11300 over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
